import { Link } from '../lib/router'

/** The page for an address the site does not have (also what hosts show through 404.html and _redirects). */
export function NotFound() {
  return (
    <section className="section">
      <div className="container prose not-found">
        <p className="eyebrow">Page not found</p>
        <h1>We could not find that page</h1>
        <p className="lead">The link may be old, or the address may have a typo.</p>
        <p>
          <Link to="/" className="button">
            Go to the home page
          </Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </section>
  )
}
